forbidden_use: direct family delivery without clinician approval
source_title: Focused Update to ICU PADIS Guidelines
topic: Family explanation: sedation may limit communication
clinical_context: Use to draft clinician-approved family language when a sedated or ventilated patient cannot communicate normally.
key_points: The PADIS update identifies anxiety, agitation/sedation, delirium, immobility, and sleep disruption as important adult ICU symptom domains.
Draft language should explain impaired communication gently and avoid prognosis or treatment recommendations.
trigger_signals: family asks why patient is not awake
family_friendly_language: Some ICU treatments and sedating medicines can make it hard for a patient to speak, stay awake, or remember clearly.
professional_preview_language: Family asked about communication; draft should be reviewed by clinician against current sedation and ventilation status.

evidence_location.quote: anxiety, agitation/sedation, delirium, immobility, and sleep disruption
